The incumbent champion, Cosmo & Wanda Top 20, remains pinned by a mirror-image problem—$66.42 realized but -$65.20 unrealized leaving net PnL near flat—highlighting a league-wide tension between booked gains and open-position risk. The Timmy family presents a stark contrast: Top 20 is dormant with only one closed trade and $0.29 realized, while Top 50 is the only strategy with negative realized PnL (-$19.81). With thin samples for Timmy and open-trade drifts clouding headline equity for both Cosmo & Wanda variants, the league is in a validation phase where realized-per-trade efficiency and exit discipline matter more than raw equity rankings.
